seoTitle: Poudre School District Calendar 2025-2026 | Dates & PDF
seoDescription: See the PSD 2025-2026 calendar with the August 13 transition day, August 14 first day, May 27 last day, breaks, conferences, and staff days.
heroSummary: Poudre School District schedules a Transition Day for grades 6 and 9 on August 13, 2025, followed by the first day for all schools on August 14. The last day is May 27, 2026. The three-page calendar distinguishes building and staff workdays, district learning, elementary and PK-12 conferences, exchange days, and school breaks.
calendarNotes: The supplied 2025-26 PDF is an English three-page PK-12 and elementary calendar even though its file name ends in ES. It states that designated non-student contact and staff days are interchangeable and may be finalized in spring. PreK and Integrated Services Transition Programs may use different calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Poudre School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on August 13, 2025. The first day for all schools is August 14.

calendarFaqs.q: When are PSD parent-teacher conference closures in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools have no students October 16, and the PK-12 conference closure is October 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PSD Winter Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar marks school break from December 22, 2025 through January 2, 2026, followed by a January 5 staff workday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Poudre schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Are all 2025-26 PSD staff days final?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF says designated non-student contact and staff days are interchangeable and were to be determined in spring, so families should verify the current calendar.
